THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
Area 8 · Klarg’s cave
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

Sacks and crates fill the far side of the cave. Smoke from a low fire climbs toward an opening above. Behind the stolen supplies, a hulking figure rises, morningstar in hand, while a wolf bares its teeth.

The stacked goods divide the cavern into patches of cover and narrow sightlines. Firelight catches the raised weapon and the wolf's teeth, while smoke drifts toward the opening overhead. The way you entered remains behind you as you choose how to answer this reception.

Ask the players

“Do you rush in, take cover, talk, withdraw, or try to split them up?”

Choices

Klarg is the sharpest damage spike for a level-1 PC. Give tracks, noise, or frightened goblins as warning. Reassess only after seeing the five actual character sheets.
